mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the 20-day windows following a month with FEDFUNDS below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market deterioration that may presage economic weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the 5-day windows following a month with UNRATE above 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous labor market weakness (UNRATE > 5.5%) and manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100) signal heightened recession risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5% and INDPRO < 100, SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of the subsequent 60-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% indicates an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the subsequent 20-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (above 1000.0) reflects strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the 5-day windows following a month with HOUST above 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing production index below 100 indicates economic contraction in the industrial sector, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the subsequent 60-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 400000) combined with robust housing starts (HOUST > 1000) signals a resilient economy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 400000 and HOUST > 1000, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the subsequent 20-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: Excessive consumer spending (RSAFS > 450000) may indicate overvaluation in the consumer sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 450000, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the subsequent 5-day windows.
